inputs.text: I just got word out of Paris, France about this conviction of Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), under France’s new law targeting “psychological subjection.” It’s sending ripples of concern through religious communities and civil liberties advocates, but that’s exactly how these setups work. This isn’t some neutral crackdown on abuse like they claim. It’s the hidden elites and institutions rolling out coordinated tools to manipulate and suppress religious groups that challenge their control. They invert the story to paint the law as protection while it’s really about subjecting people to their narrative and silencing dissent. The timing and targeting of figures like this abbot screams manipulation, and the so-called controversy is just cover for their agenda.
